field.title: Служба национальных парков США · Как работают археологи
field.passage: Body. Survey locates clusters and test spots. Excavation alters the site and proceeds unit by unit, photographing and drawing exposed surfaces. Surveying uses a fixed datum, measurement grid and total station. Screening separates finds from soil; fine water screening recovers small finds.

survey.title: Служба национальных парков США · Как археологи находят памятники
survey.passage: Above-ground, Noninvasive Techniques. Systematic walkover records evidence from the surface. Archive research examines historic maps, documents and photographs. Oral histories can be passed down between generations. Ground-penetrating radar and electrical resistivity are examples of geophysical methods.

awl.title: Смитсоновский институт · Костяные шилья
awl.passage: Making clothing. Blombos bone awls, and awls or perforators as tools for piercing clothing.

needles.title: Смитсоновский институт · Иглы из кости и слоновой кости
needles.passage: Making well fitted clothing. Bone needles from Xiaogushan date to about 30,000–23,000 years ago. Similar needles were used to sew fitted clothing.
